_readme: CLAIM CLOCK registry: time-bound facts that must not be written in present tense before they are true (or after they stop being true). status = what we last verified (announced|operating|ended); the scanner trusts DATES over status: a claim is 'announced' until valid_from, 'operating' inside [valid_from, valid_until], 'ended' after valid_until (or when status=ended). kind=route uses operating-wording rules (ERROR); kind=period only flags ended periods (WARN). match.subject = ANY of these regexes must hit the sentence; match.object = ANY must hit (object_scope 'sentence' = same sentence only, 'window' = sentence plus the 3 lines above for list items, 'document' = anywhere in the same file - for carriers that are only wrong in lists/overviews of Zanzibar travel). Regexes are case-insensitive unicode. ADD A CLAIM whenever copy depends on a start/end date. Sources are what the date was checked against - re-verify before flipping status.
